# `aitbc exchange verify`

Read-only exchange-book verifier (scripts/ops/exchange_verify.py). Re-derives the exchange DB's funding and settlement claims. Read-only by construction: DBs open ``mode=ro`` and ``--no-chain`` is passed unless an RPC endpoint is given explicitly. The script's output and exit code pass through unchanged (exit 1 when any check FAILs).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange verify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--db` | text | — | no | Exchange SQLite DB path under /var/lib/aitbc/ (absolute, existing regular file, no symlinks). Default: the service path the script resolves (EXCHANGE_DATABASE_URL / AITBC_DATA_DIR exchange.db) |
| `--bridge-db` | text | — | no | bridge_deposits.db path under /var/lib/aitbc/ — enables the prepay cross-check (default: BRIDGE_DEPOSITS_DB env var) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint — enables eth-chain checks |
| `--ait-rpc` | text | — | no | AITBC chain RPC base URL — enables AIT checks with --escrow-address |
| `--escrow-address` | text | — | no | Sell-escrow account address for AIT checks |
| `--bridge-address` | text | — | no | Expected deposit destination (enforces `to` on prepays) |
| `--settlement` | flag | `false` | no | Declare EXCHANGE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED on for this DB — a registered node with orders but no eth_address is then a FAIL |
| `--json` | flag | `false` | no | Machine-readable output |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange verify
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc exchange verify --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
